plan.summary: This 4-week block is a simple off-camp build for a beginner boxer training around higher sparring load with only one 45-minute S&C session each week. Week 1 establishes a baseline on the main lower-body lift so future loading can be adjusted cleanly, and the main program starts in Week 2. The focus for this block is crisp power work first, then foundational strength, then practical trunk and pulling work without adding unnecessary fatigue to boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build basic lower-body power, squat strength, trunk stiffness, and pulling strength with low-complexity work that fits around sparring.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Gradually raise force output on the main lifts while keeping weekly fatigue controlled and sessions efficient.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift more of the work toward faster, sharper outputs while maintaining the strength built earlier.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Stick each landing softly and jump as fast as possible. Stop if jump height drops off.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low box and land quietly with full control.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Pause briefly at the bottom and drive straight up.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with small jumps in load, then work up to one hard set of 5 reps with solid depth and form. This sets your baseline for future loading.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 5 reps. Stop before form breaks and log the load and reps.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the heaviest clean top set of 5 with full depth and steady control.
